sub_answers.text: The club left the Tasmanian Football League in 2001 and joined the Southern Football League at that time [d8767658s0p0]. North Hobart was invited into the statewide league in 2009 and remained there until 2013 [d8767658s0p0]. After the 2013 season its position in the league was effectively filled by the Hobart City Football Club, and North Hobart later returned to the Tasmanian State League in 2018 [d8767658s0p0]. Following the cessation of the TSL in 2024 the club rejoined the Southern Football League in 2025 [d8767658s0p0].

sub_answers.text: The club has won Tasmanian State Premierships in the following years: 1914, 1920, 1923, 1929, 1936, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1945, 1961, 1962 and 1969 [d8767658s1p0]. In the 1967 TANFL Grand Final North Hobart defeated Glenorchy 11.12 (78) to 8.16 (64) to win the premiership by 14 points [d8767658s5p0]. After winning the 1967 TANFL premiership the club played in the 1967 Tasmanian State Premiership Final against Wynyard which was declared no result (Wynyard 13.14 (92) v North Hobart 12.19 (91)) after fans invaded the field and removed the goal posts, and the state premiership was withheld [d8767658s5p0].
